tasks.gr8-social-and-environmental-responsibil: Topic: Social and environmental responsibility. Cover environmental health, pollution, water, waste, conservation, and practical local action. Ask Grade 8 learners to identify community environmental problems, evaluate responsible behaviour, and choose realistic ways to protect shared spaces.
tasks.gr8-health-and-risk-behaviour-t2: Topic: Health and risk behaviour. Cover substance abuse, unsafe situations, refusal skills, personal safety, and resilience. Ask Grade 8 learners to assess risks in everyday scenarios, select safer responses under pressure, and recognise support systems that strengthen healthy choices.
tasks.gr8-community-responsibility-t2: Topic: Community responsibility. Cover community services, reporting channels, empathy, volunteering, and care for shared spaces. Ask Grade 8 learners to match needs with services, identify positive contribution opportunities, and apply respectful citizenship in school and community settings.
tasks.gr8-physical-education-task-t2: Topic: Physical Education Task. Cover net or wall games, agility, endurance, coordination, cooperation, and safe participation. Ask Grade 8 learners to identify movement skills, game rules, and teamwork behaviours that improve performance and reduce injury risk.
tasks.gr8-career-categories-t2: Topic: The six career categories and the role of work (Grade 8 Life Orientation, Term 2). Cover realistic, investigative, artistic, social, enterprising and conventional categories, linking interests and strengths to categories, and the role of work in meeting social and economic needs in South Africa. Ask the learner directly (you).
